g2bulk.name: G2Bulk
g2bulk.summary: Supplier for game top-ups and digital cards. The API key is used on the server only.
g2bulk.apiKeyHelp: The key is stored in store settings and never shown again after saving. It is never sent to the browser.
g2bulk.apiKeyKeepHelp: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
g2bulk.markupHelp: Applied to the supplier cost to calculate your selling price on import.
g2bulk.importHint: Fetch the provider's game list and choose what to add to your store.
g2bulk.verified: The key is valid and the provider connection works.

errors.invalid_input: Check the values you entered, then try again.
errors.auth: The provider rejected the key. Check it — we do not retry automatically, to avoid an IP ban.
errors.rate_limit: We hit the provider's rate limit. Try again shortly.
errors.server: The provider service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.network: We could not reach the provider. Check connectivity and try again.
errors.contract: The provider replied in an unexpected shape. Nothing was changed.

sam.name: Sam API — customer wallet top-ups
sam.summary: Lets a customer top up their own wallet: they transfer to your ShamCash or Syriatel Cash wallet through Sam, and the server asks Sam whether the transfer actually arrived. Once confirmed the balance is credited automatically, unless you turn on manual review below.
sam.apiKeyHelp: From your Sam dashboard. Stored on the server and never shown again.
sam.apiKeyKeepHelp: Leave blank to keep the current key.
sam.shamcashHelp: The wallet customers' money arrives in. Use “Show wallets” to find the right value.
sam.syriatelHelp: The phone number or cash code of your wallet.
sam.currencyHelp: What the customer pays in. Their wallet is credited in dollars either way.
sam.rateHelp: Used to convert the requested amount into pounds when the invoice is created.
sam.enabledHelp: When on, customers see it on the wallet top-up page.
sam.manualReviewLabel: Review every payment myself before crediting
sam.manualReviewHelp: Default: when Sam confirms the money arrived, the balance is credited immediately. With this on, even a confirmed payment waits for your approval on the top-up requests page.
sam.testHelp: Checks the key and lists the wallets linked to your Sam account with their balances.
sam.walletsEmpty: The key works, but no wallets are linked to this Sam account. Link one in your Sam dashboard and try again.
sam.walletsDescription: Loaded straight from Sam with the saved key. Seeing your wallet here means the key works.
sam.walletsNoKey: Add your Sam API key above and save. Your wallets, balances, and recent transfers will appear here.
sam.historyDescription: The last movements Sam reports on this wallet, whether or not they came from this store.
sam.historyEmpty: Sam reports no movements on this wallet yet.
sam.historyUnavailable: Sam could not read this wallet's transfers
sam.webhookDescription: Sam calls this address the moment a customer's payment lands, and the store credits the wallet. It contains a secret that proves the call really came from Sam — treat it like a password, and do not paste it anywhere public.
sam.webhookMissing: No secret yet — save your settings once to generate it.
sam.webhookRegenerateHelp: Only if you believe the current one leaked. Invoices already waiting for payment will stop crediting automatically.
sam.webhookRegenerated: A new secret is in place. Sam will use it for invoices from now on.
sam.webhookLocalBody: It points at this machine, so Sam's servers can never deliver a payment notification to it. Customer payments will not credit on their own until the store runs on its public address. Until then a customer can still confirm a payment from the payment page, and you can approve it from the top-up requests page.
sam.webhookInsecureBody: The callback carries a secret, so it must use HTTPS. Set your public site address to an https:// URL.

errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.invalid_shamcash: A ShamCash identifier must be 32 characters of letters and digits.
errors.invalid_syriatel: A Syriatel identifier must be a 09XXXXXXXX phone number or an 8-digit cash code.
errors.missing_rate: Enter an exchange rate above zero to invoice in Syrian pounds.
errors.not_configured: Add the Sam API key first.
errors.auth: Sam rejected the key. Check it was copied in full and the subscription is active.
errors.wallet: Sam reports a problem with the wallet: re-link it in your Sam dashboard and try again.
errors.not_found: Sam could not find that wallet. Use “Show wallets” and pick one from the list.
errors.validation: Sam rejected the request. Check the identifier and currency.
errors.provider: Sam listed your wallet but could not reach the wallet provider to read it. This is on Sam's side, not your setup — it usually clears on its own, and re-linking the wallet in your Sam dashboard is the next step if it does not.
errors.network: Could not reach Sam. Check the connection.
errors.contract: Sam replied unexpectedly. Check your Sam dashboard.
errors.unknown: Could not complete that. Try again.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Follow every order, read what the supplier answered, and step in when a delivery is stuck.
orders.emptyDescription: Orders appear here as soon as a customer completes a purchase.
orders.emptyFilteredDescription: No order matches that search or status.
orders.snapshotNote: Names and prices as they were at purchase, not as the catalog reads now.
orders.noAccountFields: This package needed no extra details.
orders.noAttempts: No delivery has been attempted yet.
orders.rawHint: Shown exactly as the supplier sent it.
orders.noTransactions: No wallet movement is recorded against this order.
orders.opsDescription: Use these when automatic delivery cannot finish the order on its own.
orders.opsSettled: This order is settled: it can no longer be retried or marked delivered.
orders.reconcileDescription: Checkout waits about ten seconds for the supplier. This is what goes back later for the orders it could not wait for. It only ever asks the supplier — it never buys.
orders.reconcileNeverRun: This has not run yet. Run it once to check any orders still waiting on the supplier.
orders.retryDescription: Sends the order to the supplier again. It cannot buy twice, because the same attempt key is kept.
orders.deliverDescription: For what you handed over yourself, outside the system. It does not touch the wallet, because the money was taken at checkout.
orders.deliverNoteHint: The note is kept in the audit log and reaches the customer with the notification.
orders.markedDelivered: The order is marked delivered and the customer has been notified.

retryOutcomes.processing: The supplier is working on it. Refresh to follow the status.
retryOutcomes.failed: Delivery failed again. Read the latest attempt below.
retryOutcomes.skipped: Nothing was sent to the supplier: the package is not mapped to a product, or the player details are missing.

recharges.description: Review requests and credit balance once you have confirmed the payment arrived.
recharges.emptyDescription: Recharge requests appear here once customers create them.
recharges.creditAmountHint: Leave empty to credit the requested amount as is.

recharges.manualReviewNote: A manual transfer is not proof that money arrived, so every manual request waits for your approval and nothing is credited before it. Automatic crediting exists only for Sam API payments — where the server can ask the provider whether the transfer really happened — and is configured on the APIs page.

payments.title: Payments and wallet credits
payments.description: Every top-up next to the wallet credit it produced. The two should always agree; this is where they are compared.
payments.allClearDescription: Every payment taken has a matching wallet credit. Nothing needs you here.
payments.emptyDescription: Top-ups appear here as soon as a customer requests one.

explain.not_credited: The money arrived but the wallet was never credited. The customer has paid and has nothing to show for it — credit them from their customer page, or find out why the credit did not land.
explain.unbacked: This wallet was credited with no payment behind it. It costs the store rather than the customer, so check whether it was a deliberate correction.
explain.short_paid: Less arrived than was requested. Decide whether to credit the smaller amount or ask the customer for the difference.

logs.description: What administrators have done, and what the provider syncs and sweeps recorded.
logs.emptyDescription: Hand-made changes — a delivery marked complete, a balance corrected, an administrator added — appear here with who made them.
